connection.preparingBody: Our secure Meta WhatsApp Cloud API integration is being prepared for live onboarding. You can explore all supported capabilities below.

capabilities.title: What can you do on WhatsApp?
capabilities.subtitle: SmartLegal-AI brings core legal assistance capabilities straight to your mobile chat.

questions.title: Legal Questions
questions.description: Ask everyday legal questions and receive plain-language guidance grounded in Indian legal frameworks.

analysis.title: Document Analysis
analysis.description: Send supported legal documents (PDFs or images up to 25 MB) through WhatsApp for rapid contract analysis.

risk.title: Legal Risk Understanding
risk.description: Understand critical risk ratings, high-risk clauses, obligations, and suggested next steps.

drafting.title: Progressive Legal Drafting
drafting.description: Progressively provide requirements and key terms through guided chat to work toward a legal draft.

context.title: Context Preservation
context.description: Seamlessly continue discussing active documents and legal contexts without restarting conversation workflows.

multilingual.title: Multilingual Assistance
multilingual.description: Get responses in English, Hindi, or Marathi, and change your language setting anytime.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Get started in three simple steps.

open.title: Open WhatsApp
open.description: Start a conversation with the SmartLegal-AI WhatsApp assistant.

send.title: Ask or Send
send.description: Ask a legal question or send a supported agreement (PDF or Image).

help.title: Get Legal Help
help.description: Receive clear, plain-language legal guidance and risk breakdown directly in chat.

documentUseCase.formats: Supported Formats: PDF & Image (Up to 25 MB)

documentUseCase.body: Send an agreement, contract, or supported legal document directly in your chat. SmartLegal-AI analyzes it and helps you understand important clauses, risk ratings, and next steps.
